Question: In triangle \(ABC,\) \(CD\) is the altitude to \(AB\) and \(AE\) is the altitude to \(BC.\) If the lengths of \(AB,\) \(CD,\) and \(AE\) are known, the length of \(DB\) is:

Choices.A: not determined by the information given
Choices.B: determined only if \(A\) is an acute angle
Choices.C: determined only if \(B\) is an acute angle
Choices.D: determined only if \(ABC\) is an acute triangle
